descripcion: Greet, present and recognize key sounds of Italian: c / ci / ch, g / gi / gh, gn / gli, double consonants and accents.
Nationalities, professions and present of essere, avere and regular verbs in -are, -ere and -ire.
Counting, talking about the family, using possessive and forming articles, plurals and concordant adjectives.
Describe places and objects with articles, negation, c è / ci sono and frequent prepositions.
Talk about routines and schedules, use articulated prepositions and read hours, days and frequencies.
Express taste, order food and talk about common amounts, measures and pains.
Read prices and quantities, use demonstrative and express calendar dates.
Place places, follow directions and read information about studies, work and time.
Talk about hobbies and preferences; include short profiles and personal messages.
Recognize recent past and sequences; read schedules, tickets and accommodation indications.
Choose to break or essere, recognize participles and match the participle with direct pronouns.
Forming the imperfect, combining it with prossimo and trapassate passate, and expressing current duration.
Use direct and indirect pronouns, combine them with manners and match them in composite times.
Compare and express degrees, superlatives, identity and quantity with common undefined.
Talk about plans with present and future, express conjectures and recognize irregular roots.

titulo_es: The body, the advice and the pharmacy
descripcion: Understand tips and instructions with imperatives of your, noi, voi and Lei.
Read rules and services; use gerunde, progressive perifrase and time markers.
Read travel and housing notices, express duration and use time and place prepositions.
Matizar with adverbs, già / ancora / appena and follow real conditions in short texts.

titulo_it: Mi ha detto che è stanco
titulo_es: Say what someone said, relative, «prima di» and final review
descripcion: Integrate connectors, references and real conditions into a final A2 reading.
To order before, context and facts concluded with trapassate, imperfect, prossimo passato and future.

titulo_es: The conditional: wishes, advice and what would have happened
descripcion: Forming conditional present and past, using courtesy and advice, and recognizing assistants in composite times.
Practice congiuntive forms and uses with opinion, desire and need; distinguish certainty and choose between infinitive and «che».
Contrast real and hypothetical conditions and follow the relationship between condition and result.

titulo_it: Mi ha detto che era stanco
descripcion: Interpret temporary and person changes in indirect discourse, questions and related orders.

titulo_it: Il posto più bello del mondo
titulo_es: Compare, relative and who or what
descripcion: Compare accurately and recognize che, cui and dove according to the relative function.
Combine pronouns and understand the reference of ci / ne and the concordance in composite times.
Form gerundios, use stare + gerundio and its pronouns; distinguish if impersonal and passivant with agreement.

titulo_es: Causes, contrasts, time and organization of the speech
descripcion: Follow the relationship of cause, purpose, concession, contrast and consequence with connectors.

titulo_es: Work, formal messages and practical reading
descripcion: Read stories, news, notices and procedures; infer vocabulary and review B1 structures.
Recognize passive in composite times, innuances of venire / andare and concordance with if passivant and manners.

titulo_es: The remote past to tell the story
descripcion: Read regular and irregular remote passage in biographies and narrations, according to record and sequence.

titulo_es: Infinitive and gerunde: before, cause and mode
descripcion: To interpret before, cause and mode with infinitive and gerundio, and to distinguish which action is omitted with senza.

titulo_es: Congiuntive passate and trapassate, and the concordance of times
descripcion: To relate main and subordinate time, including related to specific or non-specific antecedent.

titulo_es: The ipotetici periods of possibility, of past and mixed unreality
descripcion: Interpret past and mixed unreal conditions, and comparisons with se.
Interpret il cui and relative without express antecedent according to gender, number and function.

titulo_es: Granting, result, purpose, time and exception
descripcion: Continue granting, purpose, time and exception with subjunctive and complex connectors.

titulo_es: Predicominal, indefinite and adverbian verbs in -mind
descripcion: Recognize pronominal verbs, nominalizations and nuances of evaluation in texts.

titulo_es: React, ask and read texts B2
descripcion: Analyze news, opinions and instructions, contrasting thesis, evidence, reservations and conditions.

titulo_es: Formal registration, previous future and complex indirect discourse
descripcion: Read contracts, bank notices, accounts and guides; interpret record, previous future and indirect discourse.
